topic: The Geometric Intuition of Linear Systems: Spaces and Inverses

sections.title: Visualizing Linear Systems (1 min)
lecture_lines: Linear systems map inputs to target vectors.
Matrix columns define the new coordinate space.
We search for x mapping to b.
animations: Create a 2D plane with two vectors as basis [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg].
Show the linear combination of vectors in the plane.
Highlight the span of the two vectors [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg].

sections.title: Column Space: The Reachable World (1 min)
lecture_lines: Column space is the span of matrix columns.
It represents all possible transformation outcomes.
Dependent columns collapse the reachable space.
animations: Display matrix columns as individual vectors in space.
Show the span formed by these column vectors.
Highlight the resulting reachable output space.

sections.title: Null Space: The 'Ghost' Inputs (1 min)
lecture_lines: Null space maps non-zero inputs to origin.
It highlights ambiguity in the transformation.
Information is lost along null space directions.
animations: Draw a vector that maps to the zero vector [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Highlight the set of all such vectors.
Label this set as the null space [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Inverse Matrices: The Rewind Button (1 min)
lecture_lines: The inverse matrix reverses the transformation.
Inverses exist only for bijective mappings.
We reconstruct the original input from output.
animations: Display a forward linear transformation on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Show the inverse transformation effectively reversing the action.
Highlight the return to original [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] state.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary (1 min)
lecture_lines: No null space means the system is invertible.
Incomplete column space creates unreachable targets.
Inverse operations uniquely return to the start.
animations: Animate the transition between span and null space concepts.
Show how column space and null space relate together.
Summarize the transformation process as a final visual.
